newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Q3 GDP 7.3 pct yr/yr vs 5.2 pct in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Polish Q3 GDP 7.3 pct yr/yr vs 5.2 pct in Q2.

text.p: Poland's gross domestic product growth rate rose to 7.3 percent year on year, unadjusted, in the third quarter from 5.2 percent in the second quarter, the deputy head of the Central Statistical Office said on Monday.
Roman Sawinski told a news conference the increase was mainly the result of growing domestic demand on the back of the fast growth of wages in real terms.
"Fast (economic) growth is the result of quick increases of consumer demand...and a rise in real wages," Sawinski said.
